description: Compares two birth charts (synastry): the closest aspects between person A's and person B's planets, with orbs and a short, balanced summary. Birth times and places are optional. Instead of person_b you can pass `celebrity` (name or X handle, see list_celebrities) for a playful star match with a score and a share text for X. No predictions, nothing stored.

celebrity.description: Optional: name or X handle of a famous person from list_celebrities (for example 'Elon Musk' or '@elonmusk'). Use instead of person_b.

birth_date.description: Birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format, for example 1988-03-14.

birth_place.description: Optional birth place: any town worldwide with 1000+ inhabitants (offline GeoNames list, CC BY 4.0), Dutch names like 'Den Haag' or 'Keulen' work. Add region or country when a name is common, e.g. 'Springfield, Illinois' or 'Hengelo, Gelderland'. Alternatively give latitude, longitude and timezone.

birth_time.description: Optional local birth time, HH:MM 24-hour, for example 07:45. Needed for Ascendant, houses and an exact Moon.

latitude.description: Optional birth latitude in decimal degrees (north positive), used instead of birth_place.

longitude.description: Optional birth longitude in decimal degrees (east positive), used instead of birth_place.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the birth place, for example Europe/Amsterdam. Required with latitude/longitude; historical daylight saving time is handled automatically.
